name: conflict-docs
about: The PR's only conflict with main is in docs/: land merges main into the branch in a scratch worktree with git's union driver (both sides kept, no -X), pushes the merge to the item's loop/ branch (not forced), and sends the new head back to review for a fresh review; nothing is merged yet.

data.notes: conflicts only in docs/ \(docs/notes\.md\), both sides kept by git's union merge
